en-US.releaseNotes: ## Quick Start ### Non-HA: ```shell kubectl create namespace argocd kubectl apply -n argocd --server-side --force-conflicts -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/v3.6.1/manifests/install.yaml ``` ### HA: ```shell kubectl create namespace argocd kubectl apply -n argocd --server-side --force-conflicts -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/v3.6.1/manifests/ha/install.yaml ``` ## Release Signatures and Provenance All Argo CD container images are signed by cosign. A Provenance is generated for container images and CLI binaries which meet the SLSA Level 3 specifications. See the [documentation](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/operator-manual/signed-release-assets) on how to verify. ## Release Notes Blog Post For a detailed breakdown of the key changes and improvements in this release, check out the [official blog post](https://blog.argoproj.io/argo-cd-v3-0-release-candidate-a0b933f4e58f) ## Upgrading If upgrading from a different minor version, be sure to read the [upgrading](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/operator-manual/upgrading/overview/) documentation. ## Changelog ### Bug fixes • 94037c4d4e1af4bd0651d37a179fbd9e347e668c：fix(ui): keep the sidebar layout in sync after toggling it (cherry-pick #30762 for 3.6) (#30771) (@shimagrawal) • abfc76157c9a9bcdc4b4161077e4e0e7993493fe：fix(ui): stop webpack minifying index.html so --rootpath/--basehref work (#30763) (cherry-pick #30767 for 3.6) (#30768) (@argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot]) ### Other work • c7c41d322fb1592b09c72448ac439abc3c69af48：chore: bump version to 3.6.1 on release-3.6 branch (#30769) (@github-actions[bot]) **Full Changelog**：https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/compare/v3.6.0...v3.6.1
